Name: Simply Sour Cherry
Author: Macskasajt
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]You must need Platonic's Recipes to use this mod!

I always felt like there should be sour cherries in the game. You can make the following foods from the fruit:

- Cognac Cherries
- Compote
- Soup
- Sponge Cakes
- Strudel
- Pálinka
- Wine
- Tea
- Possibly more in the future...



[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/27323031]martin66789[/url], who helped a lot with the Hungarian translations. [/font]
